svg.data-weight-note: 14.33 lb (6.49 kg) chassis without fans or PSUs. Fan module 0.26 lb (0.12 kg). One row, 2.64 lb (1.2 kg), for all eight supplies including the 1900 W.
svg.data-poe-power-supplies: guide: "48 PoE++ (60W ports) - two 1900W power supplies needed"; "21 PoE++ (60W ports) - one 1900W power supplies needed"; "Non-PoE - one or two 350W power supplies needed"
svg.data-ports-t: guide: "40 10M/100M/1G copper RJ45 downlink ports that support PoE/PoE+/PoE++ and 8 10M/100M copper RJ45 downlink ports that support PoE/PoE+/PoE++"; "Ports 41-48 support 10M/100M half-duplex only"
svg.data-management-ports: rear figure: one RJ-45 and one SFP management port, and a console port
